bundle.shortDescription: Dynodoc: version control for documents, on your computer
bundle.longDescription: Dynodoc desktop manages document repositories, history, drafts, change requests, reviews and synchronization. Edit in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Docs, Sheets or Slides using the add-ins and extensions. Local history works on this computer; connect a Dynodoc server to synchronize, and open the web workspace in your browser.
